fallos_mitigaciones: Sec.2.2: cosine-similarity relevance gating cannot distinguish blocks with similar vocabulary but opposite intent (e.g. always-use vs never-use the same format) -- mitigated by mandating fine-grained one-concept-per-block authoring, which both improves gate precision and surfaces semantic contradictions structurally before compilation. benchmarks: NINGUNO (production Hermes Agent deployment, 5 profiles; custom controlled BCP experiments T3/T4/T5, 210 trials; no public benchmark)
fallos_mitigaciones: Central topic = 'channel fracture': a systematic SILENT failure where scheduled(cron) agent sessions cannot access the target agent's memory tools (skip_memory=True hardcoded scheduler guard + conditional memory-tool registration bypassed in cron context, Sec.2.2-2.3/Listing1-2) -- writer-side verification passes while receiver-side memory stays empty, undetectable without inverse (receiver-side) verification. Mitigated by CADVP v1.1's veto-level CC-0 channel-confirmation check plus the Three-Gate Quality System (L1 self-verification/L2 evidence-hash/L3 cross-review) and the BCP reference implementation, cutting concurrent-write corruption from 67-98% to 0.00% (Table8), raising rollback success 0%->100% (Table7) and relay info-preservation 87-94%->100% (Table6).

benchmarks: custom automotive traceability case study (535 artifacts across 6 subsystems: AEB, LKA, BMS, IVI, V2X, DMS; human-validated ground-truth traceability matrices); baselines TF-IDF+Cosine, Embedding-only, LLM-only; no public benchmark
fallos_mitigaciones: Sec.III-F: two conflict types treated as failure modes of the shared memory -- (1) Confidence Divergence Conflict: gap |c_seed - c_val| > delta=0.5 between a derivation agent's self-assessed confidence and the validation agent's independent reassessment, indicating semantic drift introduced during derivation; (2) Cross-Cluster Ambiguity Conflict: a software requirement holds valid links to system requirements in semantically distant clusters, indicating it serves two unrelated concerns. Mitigated by the consistency protocol (confidence threshold gating + divergence detection + conflict materialization as first-class Conflict graph nodes for human review, Sec.III-F.3); Experiment2 ablation (Table IV, tau in{0.3,0.5,0.6,0.8} x epsilon in{0.3..0.7}, 120 configs) finds (tau=0.5,epsilon=0.4) achieves TP=10/FN=0 with zero false positives across all 120 configurations.
